title: 第0017章 长老会的博弈与系统的深度觉醒第0018章 仙茅破障一拳惊雷
content_zh:
------
清晨的阳光透过雕花木窗，洒在林药尘略显简陋的床榻上。
一夜调息，他体内的气息已彻底稳固在药徒三重巅峰。昨日在演武场上吞服的那枚聚气散，其药力在仙鹤草的转化下，并未如寻常修士般散逸，而是尽数沉淀于四肢百骸，铸就了一副坚实的“药体”雏形。
“这就是药武同修吗？”林药尘握了握拳，指节发出炒豆般的爆鸣声。寻常药徒三重，仅是炼药之徒，肉身孱弱；但他此刻的力量，竟不输于淬体境四重的武者。
这，便是八大奇药赋予他的根基。仙鹤草固元，让他无惧药力冲击；药尊系统优化，让他炼药即是修武。
“咚——”
一声沉闷的钟鸣自林家正殿方向传来，悠长而肃杀。
林药尘眉头一挑。这是“聚议钟”，非家族大事不鸣。看来，昨日演武场那一拳，不仅打碎了林啸天的胸骨，也彻底打碎了林家表面的平静。
他起身，换上那件洗得发白的青衫，神色平静如水。该来的，总会来。与其被动躲避，不如主动迎击。
当他行至正殿广场时，这里早已黑压压站满了林家子弟。众人看向他的目光极为复杂，有畏惧，有不屑，更多的则是幸灾乐祸。在他们看来，打伤主脉少主，无异于以卵击石，今日必是身死道消之局。
大殿之内，气氛压抑得令人窒息。
家主林震山高坐主位，面色阴沉得能滴出水来。林啸天躺在一张软榻上，胸口缠着厚厚的绷带，脸色惨白，眼神怨毒地盯着走进大殿的林药尘。
左侧首位，是一位须发皆白的老者，正是家族大长老林擎天，也是林啸天的亲爷爷。右侧，则坐着三位身着丹纹长袍的老者，乃是家族的“丹堂三老”，掌管家族炼药事务。
“林药尘，见家主与大长老。”林药尘步入大殿，拱手行礼，不卑不亢，仿佛昨日那个一拳轰飞少主的人不是他一般。
“孽障！你还敢来？”大长老林擎天猛地一拍扶手，狂暴的威压瞬间笼罩全场，那是武王级别的强大气息，“你残害同门，打伤少主，罪无可恕！今日，老夫便代家法，废你修为，以正家风！”
话音未落，一股如山如狱的掌风已然隔空印向林药尘的胸口！这一掌若是落实，林药尘纵有仙鹤草护体，也必经脉尽碎，成为真正的废人！
“放肆！”
就在千钧一发之际，一道清冷的女声自殿外传来，紧接着，一道曼妙的身影如流光般掠入大殿，轻轻一挥袖，便将林擎天的掌风化于无形。
来人身着一袭冰蓝色长裙，容颜清丽绝伦，气质却冷若冰霜，正是苏清雪！
“大长老，对一个晚辈出手，未免有失身份吧？”苏清雪冷冷地扫了林擎天一眼，随即转向家主林震山，“家主，药尘弟弟昨日之举，乃是被逼无奈，属正当防卫。况且，他能炼出成色极佳的聚气散，正是我林家之幸，何罪之有？”

林震山脸色变幻不定。苏清雪不仅是林家客卿长老，更是北荒冰原部落的圣女，身份尊贵，连他也不得不给三分薄面。更重要的是，林药尘展现出的炼药天赋，确实让他心动。
“苏长老所言极是。”林震山权衡利弊，开口打破了僵局，“药尘打伤啸天固然有错，但事出有因。这样吧，罚他禁闭三月，抄写家规百遍，此事便就此作罢。”
“家主！这不公平！”林啸天挣扎着想要起身，却牵动了伤势，疼得龇牙咧嘴。
“闭嘴！”林擎天狠狠瞪了林啸天一眼，又阴鸷地看了林药尘一眼，冷哼道：“今日便看在家主和苏长老的面子上，饶你小命。但死罪可免，活罪难逃！家族近日需采购一批药材，你便去库房清点，若有差池，定斩不饶！”
这显然是个苦差事，意在羞辱和打压。林药尘心中冷笑，面上却恭敬应道：“药尘遵命。”
离开大殿，苏清雪追上林药尘，低声道：“药尘弟弟，大长老心胸狭隘，绝不会善罢甘休。你务必小心。”
林药尘感激地看了苏清雪一眼。这位女主在此时挺身而出，无疑是需要极大勇气的。“多谢苏姐姐，我自有分寸。”
他并未回住处，而是径直走向家族库房。他倒要看看，这林擎天能玩出什么花样。
库房阴冷潮湿，堆积如山的药材散发着霉味。负责交接的管事是个尖酸刻薄的老头，见林药尘前来，连正眼都不给一个，扔给他一本厚厚的账册，阴阳怪气道：“林大天才，这是库房的药材清单。三日内，全部清点入库，若有丝毫差错，仔细你的皮！”
林药尘接过账册，神识一扫，嘴角勾起一抹嘲讽的弧度。这账册上记载了数千种药材，数量庞大，且其中夹杂了大量年份不足、甚至以次充好的劣质药材。林擎天这是要借题发挥，让他完不成任务，再行问罪。
“看来，不动用系统的力量是不行了。”林药尘眼中闪过一丝精光。
他盘膝坐在库房角落，心念一动，沟通脑海中的“万古药尊系统”。
“系统，能否解析库房内所有药材的属性与年份？”
【叮！检测到宿主处于特殊环境，触发系统新功能——‘药界之眼’！】
【药界之眼：宿主可消耗少量精神力，透视药材本质，辨别真伪，解析年份与药效。】
林药尘心中狂喜。这简直是为库房清点量身定做的神技！
他深吸一口气，开启了“药界之眼”。
content_en:
------
The early morning sunlight shines through the carved wooden windows and onto Lin Yaochen's slightly humble bed.
After adjusting his breath overnight, the breath in his body has been completely stabilized at the third level of medicine disciple. The Qi Gathering Powder swallowed at the martial arts field yesterday, its medicinal power was transformed by Agrimony, and did not dissipate like ordinary monks. Instead, it was all deposited in the limbs and bones, creating a solid "medicine body" prototype.
"Is this fellow Yaowu practitioner?" Lin Yaochen clenched his fists, and his knuckles made a popping sound like fried beans. An ordinary third-level medicine disciple is only a practitioner of medicine refining, and his physical body is weak; but his strength at this moment is not inferior to that of a warrior at the fourth level of the body tempering realm.
This is the foundation given to him by the Eight Wonderful Medicines. The agrimony strengthens the essence, making him not afraid of the impact of medicine; the Yaozun system is optimized, allowing him to refine medicine and practice martial arts.
"Dong——"
A dull bell ringing came from the direction of the Lin family's main hall, long and solemn.
Lin Yaochen raised his eyebrows. This is the "Gathering Bell" and does not ring unless it is a family matter. It seemed that the punch in the martial arts arena yesterday not only broke Lin Xiaotian's sternum, but also completely shattered the apparent peace of the Lin family.
He stood up and put on the washed green shirt, his expression as calm as water. What is supposed to come will always come. Instead of passively avoiding, it is better to proactively attack.
When he arrived at the main hall square, the place was already crowded with the Lin family's children. Everyone looked at him with extremely complicated looks, some were fearful, some were disdainful, and most of them were gloating about his misfortune. In their view, injuring the young master of the main line is tantamount to hitting an egg with a stone. Today, it will be a fatal situation.
In the main hall, the atmosphere was oppressive and suffocating.
The head of the family, Lin Zhenshan, sat high on the throne, his face so gloomy that he could shed tears. Lin Xiaotian was lying on a soft couch with a thick bandage on his chest. His face was pale and he stared at Lin Yaochen who walked into the hall with resentful eyes.
The first person on the left is an old man with white beard and hair. He is Lin Qingtian, the elder of the family and Lin Xiaotian's grandfather. On the right side, there are three old men wearing alchemy robes. They are the "three elders of the alchemy hall" of the family and are in charge of the family's medicine refining affairs.
"Lin Yaochen, meet the head of the family and the first elder." Lin Yaochen walked into the hall, raised his hands and saluted, neither humble nor overbearing, as if he was not the one who punched the young master away yesterday.
"Obstacle! You still dare to come?" The great elder Lin Qingtian slapped the armrest suddenly, and the violent pressure instantly enveloped the whole place. It was a powerful aura at the level of King Wu, "You harmed your fellow disciples and injured the young master. Your sin is unforgivable! Today, I will act on behalf of the family and abolish your cultivation to correct the family tradition!"
Before he finished speaking, a palm wind like a mountain and a prison had already hit Lin Yaochen's chest through the air! If this palm is implemented, even if Lin Yaochen has agrimony to protect his body, his meridians will be shattered and he will become a real useless person!
"Presumptuous!"
At the critical moment, a cold female voice came from outside the hall, and then, a graceful figure swept into the hall like a stream of light. With a gentle wave of his sleeve, Lin Qingtian's palm was invisible.
The person who came was wearing an icy blue dress, with a beautiful face but a cold temperament. It was Su Qingxue!
"Elder, it would be disrespectful to attack a junior, right?" Su Qingxue glanced at Lin Qingtian coldly, and then turned to the head of the family, Lin Zhenshan, "Master, what brother Yaochen did yesterday was forced to do something in self-defense. Besides, he can refine the excellent Qi Gathering Powder, which is a blessing to the Lin family. Why should he be blamed?"
Lin Zhenshan's expression changed. Su Qingxue was not only an elder of the Lin family, but also a saint of the Northern Wilderness Icefield Tribe. Her status was so high that even he had to give her a thumbs up. More importantly, Lin Yaochen's talent in refining medicine really made him excited.
"What Elder Su said is absolutely true." Lin Zhenshan weighed the pros and cons and broke the deadlock, "It is certainly wrong for Yao Chen to injure Xiaotian, but there are reasons. Let's do this. We will punish him with confinement for three months and copy the family rules a hundred times, and let this matter be over."
"Master! This is unfair!" Lin Xiaotian struggledHe tried to get up, but his injuries were affected, and he grimaced in pain.
"Shut up!" Lin Qingtian glared at Lin Xiaotian fiercely, then glanced at Lin Yaochen with a sinister look, and snorted coldly: "Today, for the sake of the head of the family and Elder Su, I will spare your life. But you can avoid the death penalty, but you cannot escape the crime of living! The family needs to purchase a batch of medicinal materials recently, so you go to the warehouse to count it. If there are any mistakes, you will be killed!"
This is clearly a chore meant to humiliate and suppress. Lin Yaochen sneered in his heart, but responded respectfully on his face: "Yaochen obeys your order."
After leaving the main hall, Su Qingxue caught up with Lin Yaochen and whispered: "Brother Yaochen, the elder is narrow-minded and will never give up. You must be careful."
Lin Yaochen glanced at Su Qingxue gratefully. It undoubtedly takes a lot of courage for the heroine to step forward at this time. "Thank you sister Su, I have my own sense of discretion."
He did not return to his residence, but went straight to the family warehouse. He wanted to see what tricks Lin Qingtian could play.
The warehouse was cold and damp, and the mountains of medicinal materials exuded a musty smell. The steward in charge of the handover was a sharp and mean old man. When he saw Lin Yaochen coming, he didn't even look at him. He threw him a thick account book and said angrily: "Great Genius Lin, this is the list of medicinal materials in the warehouse. Within three days, they will all be counted and stored in the warehouse. If there are any mistakes, check your skin carefully!"
Lin Yaochen took the account book, glanced at it with his consciousness, and raised a mocking arc at the corner of his mouth. Thousands of medicinal materials are recorded in this account book. The quantity is huge, and there are a large number of inferior medicinal materials that are not old enough or even shoddy. Lin Qingtian was trying to use the topic to make him unable to complete the task before he could be blamed again.
"It seems that we can't do it without using the power of the system." A glint flashed in Lin Yaochen's eyes.
He sat cross-legged in the corner of the warehouse, and with a thought, he communicated with the "Eternal Medicine Master System" in his mind.
"System, can you analyze the attributes and years of all the medicinal materials in the warehouse?"
[Ding! It is detected that the host is in a special environment and triggers a new function of the system - 'Eye of the Medicine World'! 】
[Eye of the Medicine World: The host can consume a small amount of mental energy to see through the essence of medicinal materials, identify authenticity, and analyze the year and efficacy of the medicine. 】
Lin Yaochen was ecstatic. This is a magical skill tailor-made for warehouse counting!
He took a deep breath and opened the "Eye of the Medicine World".
